page.layout: One printed page. Running head "INDEX" centred at the top. Below it, two columns of index entries: the left column first, then the right. Nothing below the columns except the catchword "cur" at the right. No page number. Handwritten pen marks in the right margin are not printed text.

main_text.l: ad Ecclesiam qui pertinent 355 spōtaneus, non
Evangelium ad gentes per Iudæos translatum 621
prædicatio exercitiū est pro augmento ecclesiæ 539.541

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "præ lege" (line break at "præ", no hyphen; may be one word); "propositā" (final mark unclear, possibly æ); "gẽtium" (mark over e uncertain); "appellati" (printed "ap" and "pellati" across a line break, hyphen unclear); "gentes per" (a small mark between the two words, read as a space); "exercitus supernus iudicandus" (line break with no visible hyphen). Italic and roman type is read by eye for the lowercase entries. Handwritten pen marks beside "est", "officium", "excidia" and "Ezechias" are not printed and were left out. The index has no printed page number.
